Native Structurizr preview uses selected structurizr-rs core, DSL and rendering
libraries from https://github.com/Helms-AI/structurizr-rs at revision
59a5c4a93bfcb11e501d81a06cd4492c01f1f890, declared MIT by upstream.
Source, attribution, license terms and local adaptation details are retained in
vendor/structurizr-rs, including Cargo.toml.upstream and UPSTREAM.md.
No browser, server, Java runtime, remote includes or scripting engine is used.
